facts.text: Bethany College requires graduating seniors to pass Comprehensive Exams consisting of two days of written tests and a one-hour oral exam before a faculty panel.

sources.title: The Bethany Plan
sources.quote: Bethany is one of the few institutions requiring both written and oral comprehensive examinations, allowing students to reflect on their academic journey and demonstrate the depth of their learning within their chosen field.

sources.title: The Bethany Plan
sources.quote: Comprehensive exams are divided into two days of written assessments, followed by a one-hour oral examination where a panel of faculty members evaluates the student's knowledge and proficiency.
